h: Atiku reacts to Tinubu's fresh $20.5bn loan request, points back to his earlier warning
p: Former vice president Atiku Abubakar has responded to President Tinubu's request for Senate approval of about $20.52 billion in foreign borrowing. He reportedly said the request vindicates a warning he made earlier about the country's debt path. The presidency has asked lawmakers to approve the loans alongside a euro-denominated facility.
more: The request is before the Senate, which has often cleared such plans quickly.
Atiku is expected to be a presidential candidate on the ADC platform in 2027.
